# Course reference implementation

`dag_builder.py` is the unmodified CS5491 course handout for **Automated
Bootstrapping Placement**, obtained from the 24 September 2026 course snapshot.
The instructor supplied the graphs, latency functions, fixed placements, scorer
and plotting helpers. They are reference material, not the project's optimisation method.

SHA-256: `47a63fd1698da64731f8b9e77067f3ef7e0889534c4e7659bb7fc113ce97acee`

- [Course project page](https://cityu-dg.instructure.com/courses/911/pages/course-project)
- [Topic handout](https://cityu-dg.instructure.com/courses/911/files/180071/download?download_frd=1)
- Original code location: Canvas, Files / Project / Automated Bootstrapping Placement.

The project owner reported on 12 November 2026 that the instructor had confirmed
permission to publish this code. The source arrived without an explicit licence
text; no additional licence or independent written permission is asserted here.
The approved public candidate includes the exact code file, so reproducing it does
not require access to the course-only source links. The course PDF/archive and
private source inventory are not included.

The loader verifies these exact bytes. A later course update requires a separate
review and calibration; it must not silently replace the reference input for the
preserved results. Publication status and dependency terms are described in
[source access](../docs/public-scope.md).
